projects.title: Logistics CDC & Warehouse History

Set the key and ordering rules for scans
Load the first batch into the shipment fact
Merge the second batch, late corrections included
Keep every version of every account

Verify the final state and the replay

projects.title: IoT Monitoring & Failure Recovery

milestones.title: Parse the sensor readings as a stream
Validate each reading against the device registry
Compute device health in event-time windows
Raise anomaly events and suppress repeats
Correlate the gateway's errors with the sensors
Survive a sink outage and restart from the checkpoint
Validate the recovery, the state and the final incidents
